heading: Series — backend restrictions
text:
### Series — backend restrictions [LNLS.4.8]

Overlays [LSER.13] (series declaration body) and [LSER.15] (accuracy
phrases).

Under `linear_scan: false`:
- Aggregations that resolve to sketch backends with O(n) worst-case
  absorb cost are compile errors ([LNLS.3.5]). Every v1 series aggregation is exact and
  non-sketch.
- All series aggregations are otherwise unrestricted under `linear_scan: false`,
  except the unbounded membership / frequency scans of [LNLS.3.11].

The set of always-allowed series backends in `linear_scan: false` (the v1 exact
set):

| Backend | Absorb | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Ring buffer | O(1) | |
| FIFO deque | O(1) amortized | Pre-allocated in `realtime`, capacity in `.dsrt` |
| Welford (cumulative) | O(1) | cumulative only |
| Monotonic deque | O(1) amortized | Pre-allocated in `realtime`, capacity in `.dsrt` |
| Reservoir (`SeriesBackendReservoir`) | O(1) | `sample <n>` |
| `SeriesBackendIntervalPulse` (interval pulse) | O(1) amortized | `active_fraction`; deque append/evict + running sum; pre-allocated in `realtime`, capacity in `.dsrt` |
| `SeriesBackendNumericIntegral` (numeric integral) | O(1) amortized | `integral`; pre-allocated in `realtime`, capacity in `.dsrt` |

**Series RT capacity source.** The
deque-family time-windowed backends — FIFO deque (`SeriesBackendFifoDeque`), monotonic deque (`SeriesBackendMonotonicDeque`),
`SeriesBackendIntervalPulse`, `SeriesBackendNumericIntegral` — take their `realtime` pre-allocated buffer capacity from the
**`.dsrt` contract** (`series[i].capacity`), sized per deployment.
The contract's capacity bounds a series' declared `capacity` and wins over it
([LSER.13.14]). A count declared in **source** — a series' `capacity: N`, a
reservoir's `sample <n>` — defines the buffer and lowers into the backing's
`max_samples` in the DSC.
